title: MLEADERSTYLE direct-writer content-type domain

scope.operation: Reject invalid direct-writer MLEADERSTYLE enum values before emitting the record.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.87 maps group 170 to Content type; Autodesk ObjectARX Managed Reference documents AcDbMLeaderStyle::ContentType as NoneContent, BlockContent, MTextContent, ToleranceContent in enum order.
scope.claim_boundary: Direct DXF writer-domain validation and emitted group 170 only; no native tolerance-content semantics or whole-document support claim.

implementation: Validate contentType <= 3 alongside the existing pre-emission checks for groups 171, 172, 173 and 177.
Preserve all four documented values and existing field serialization.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.refusal: Each selected invalid enum value refuses before publication; destination sentinel and caller model value remain unchanged.
evidence.retry: The same dx_iface retries after correcting the field to a valid value; the AC1027 output contains exact group 170/value.
evidence.matrix: Five independently mutated writer-domain fields (170, 171, 172, 173, 177) × two invalid values per domain × two encodings; 20 destination-safe refusals and 20 successful retries.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE integer, source-presence, repeated-field, version, dependency and native-rendering profiles remain open.
